_comment: sim-robust-host-timers-audit-fix-v1 bounded GPU proof config for the integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1). Purpose: prove the LAST pace-unsafe manipulation-host wall timer -- the total-move PLANNING budget (planning_wall_exceeded / PLAN_TOTAL_WALL_CAP_S) that e-stopped coldlive sample-4 BARE at the live_pose place descent -- is now on the SIM clock, so a render-starved-but-alive cuMotion plan is tolerated and NEVER e-stops without a named, sim-clock-based reason. Also exercises the converted startup grace and payload/attach ack under the same arm-feed pacing. Builds on PR 225/226/227/228/229: the per-dispatch deadline (PR 228) was already SIM; this removes the total-cap false-trip PR 228 explicitly left on the wall.
_root_cause: The fully-honest live_pose cold cycle enables the masked_depth ARM FEED (a 2nd full-res render), slowing pacing to 16-30x wall-to-sim during manipulation. coldlive sample-4 host-stack.log ended at `PLAN_WALL_DIAG state=ik future_done=False result_status=None elapsed=120.10 replans=0`: the total planning WALL cap (env RESTOCK_PLAN_WALL_CAP_S=120) tripped while the plan future had not resolved -- only ~4-8 SIM seconds had passed, the plan was alive-but-render-starved. The mission reported only `MANIP_HOST_FAILED reason='host emergency stop'` (the Isaac stop wire carries no reason). FIX: planning_wall_exceeded is now SIM-primary (RESTOCK_PLAN_TOTAL_SIM_CAP_S, default 22 sim-s) with a derived-generous frozen-sim WALL backstop (never pre-empts the sim leg for an alive planner); RESTOCK_PLAN_WALL_CAP_S is now only the wall-backstop FLOOR. A genuinely hung planner still exhausts the sim budget; a frozen sim still hits the wall backstop. Every e-stop path now prints a NAMED host-stack trigger (HOST_FAULT_ESTOP / PORT_FAULT_ESTOP) and PLAN_WALL_DIAG names the fired leg (leg=sim|wall).
_how_to_run: scripts/run_mobile_restock.py ... --stop-after collect, fully-honest live_pose (RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose, RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard,weld) + the masked_depth ARM FEED on (mast off), visuals on -- the exact coldlive stress. The STOW is the last collect move, so collect-only exercises the whole pick->carry->place->stow PLANNING sequence under the heavy arm-feed pacing (the same converted timer the place descent trips). One GPU run at a time through flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never --force; do not touch the whispr service (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB VRAM). The validator may be holding the GPU for the final proof -- do not take it unless asked. The full every-stage live_pose run (through the transfer place descent, the original sample-4 trip point) is the ultimate proof and is validator/integration-owned.
_pass: PASS = collect reaches 'succeeded transport_ready=True' with NO terminal 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED ... host emergency stop' and NO 'arm command heartbeat lost'. host-stack.log shows NO `PLAN_WALL_DIAG ... leg=wall` fire during an advancing sim (a wall-leg fire is legitimate ONLY if /clock is frozen). If any e-stop occurs it MUST be preceded by a NAMED HOST_FAULT_ESTOP / PORT_FAULT_ESTOP line (no bare emergency stop). A genuinely hung plan may log `PLAN_WALL_DIAG ... leg=sim` only if it truly exceeded RESTOCK_PLAN_TOTAL_SIM_CAP_S sim-seconds (the bounded honest failure, not the coldlive-4 false trip).
_what_to_grep: grep -nE 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED .* host emergency stop|arm command heartbeat lost' <mission-console>.log   # MUST be ABSENT
grep -n 'PLAN_WALL_DIAG' host-stack.log                                  # if present, inspect leg=; leg=wall during advancing sim = a bug
grep -nE 'HOST_FAULT_ESTOP|PORT_FAULT_ESTOP' host-stack.log              # EVERY e-stop must be named here (never bare)
grep -nE 'process has died|exit code -6' host-stack.log                  # REAL move_group deaths (recover via PR225/227 server-down paths, not the budget)
_no_required_config_key: The fix is ALWAYS-ON in scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_adapter.py (planning_wall_exceeded, the RosTransferBridge startup grace) and ros_payload.py (_wait). The no-pacing path is byte-identical (on the real rig sim==wall, the SIM leg fires at the historical bound). No mission runtime-config key is required; the env below is backward-compatible tuning.

_suggested_env.RESTOCK_PLAN_TOTAL_SIM_CAP_S: optional (default 22 sim-s = the historical PLAN_TOTAL_WALL_CAP_S). The total-move planning SIM budget across all ik/plan dispatches, re-plans and seeds. Healthy planning consumes ~1-6 sim-s even at 30x, so 22 is comfortable; raise only if a legitimately slow multi-dispatch move is observed to exceed it. Clamped [5, 600].
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_PLAN_WALL_CAP_S: now the FROZEN-SIM wall-backstop FLOOR (no longer the primary cap). A stale sim-widen (e.g. 120) is harmless -- the effective backstop is max(120, sim_cap*50) and never pre-empts the sim leg. Leave it or unset it.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_PLAN_WALL_BACKSTOP_PACING_FACTOR: optional (default 50, > the worst observed 16-30x pacing). Derives the frozen-sim wall backstop from the sim budget. Raise only if a future heavier feed pushes pacing past ~50x.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_PLAN_SIM_DEADLINE_S: keep (default 30) -- the PER-DISPATCH sim deadline from PR 228, orthogonal to the total budget above.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_STARTUP_GRACE_SIM_S: optional (default 5 sim-s). The first-frame 'no initial sensor frame' SIM grace; scales with pacing. The fm465 light rig made the old wall grace need RESTOCK_STARTUP_GRACE_S=120 -- that now only floors the wall backstop.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_PAYLOAD_ACK_SIM_S: optional (default = payload_ack_wall_s). The attach/detach ack SIM budget; the wall value becomes a generous frozen-sim backstop.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_HEARTBEAT_UNAVAILABLE_S: WIDEN under pacing (e.g. 120). The StationClient no-reply guard is a WALL backstop (default 10 s is real-rig-tight); the SIM-stage primary (RESTOCK_STAGE_UNAVAILABLE_S) is the real liveness bound. Left unchanged in code (load-bearing parking gate); set it here so a render-paced reply gap cannot false-trip.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH: UNSET for the faithful honest/live_pose carry (the coldlive stress), or 1 for a faster deterministic carry+stow

_orthogonal_to: plan-deadline-pacing-collect-fragment.json (PR 228, the per-DISPATCH sim deadline) and movegroup-estop-retry-collect-fragment.json (PR 225, real-death recovery). This lane converts the TOTAL-move planning budget (and the startup grace + ack) -- the last wall timers in the host path. All run cleanly together.
_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/restock/host_pacing_harness.py + scripts/twin/tests/test_host_timers_pacing.py drive the shipped SIM-primary + frozen-sim-wall-backstop logic (and the real RosMotionPort.planning_wall_exceeded) at 1x/16x/30x: no false-trip of a healthy producer (incl. the exact sample-4 shape), a hang caught on the SIM leg in bounded sim time, a frozen sim caught on the WALL backstop. Full audit table: docs/host_timers_audit.md.
